blocks.text: “Stranger Things” fans can look forward to another adventure as the creators of the hit sci-fi series announced an upcoming prequel, “Other Worlds: A Stranger Things Adventure,” set to premiere in 2028. Netflix announced the live-action spin-off on Friday, Nov. 6, revealing that the story will take place decades before the “Stranger Things” gang discovered the supernatural secrets in Hawkins. The announcement was accompanied by a teaser that opens with an abandoned bicycle and a radio playing music near a fenced-off area.
